items.title: Michael Max Fleming interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: Miles Davis, you never saw them with music on the bandstand.

ctx.x: He wrote “Four” — Miles Davis stole them. But I knew that then see so I’m not just coming in this music like — I’m not going to mention any music schools but it’s a little more like destiny like. Like you need to know, to get this stuff. And this is what’s good about this interview because not everybody took the path that I took. So go ahead.
Do you recall what you made on that gig?
